name: medicine ball pullover catch
description: A lying throw and catch that sends a medicine ball overhead and back. It trains explosive lat and core strength.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Pull the ball forward over your chest to throw it up toward a partner or wall.
Catch the ball with soft elbows as it returns.
Let it travel back overhead in a controlled arc.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
